notes.title: Post-Holiday Patch
notes.content:
Hope everyone had fun in the Holiday level! My favorite to set up was the train (you might see it pop up elsewhere, keep an eye out.)

Update includes lighting enhancements as well as a few other updates.
Currently working towards a bigger patch this month for bug fixes/performances and the most popular enhancements.

notes.title: Holiday Update!
notes.content:
New Holiday Level Added! Check it out in game.

Multiple performance updates, as well as lighting updates to all levels.

notes.title: Hotfix 3, Pre-Holiday Patch
notes.content:
- A few optimization fixes for Low end GPUs
- Added setting to toggle board notation 

A large holiday patch is incoming with lots more fixes for performance as well as new holiday themed content!

notes.title: Chess! Hotfix 2
notes.content:
Second hotfix to improve performance:
- improved some level optimization (more improvements to come)
- now autosaves graphics settings and reapplies settings after restart
- other small bug fixes

Chess! now defaults to the Medium graphics settings. The High setting enables Raytracing and was causing issues with some GPUs. Chess! now saves your graphics selections, so after changing resolution/window mode/graphics quality once it will load that setting each time the game starts.
Thank you everyone for the feedback, reviews, and enhancement requests!
